changesApplied.changeMade: Removed explicit acpInput.getReader().closed promise that attempted second reader acquisition. Replaced with clarifying comment explaining that lifecycle is managed by AgentSideConnection and Hono stream() helper
changesApplied.reason: Enforces ACP Bidirectional Streaming Protocol Handler specification by eliminating ReadableStream locking error. ndJsonStream already acquires reader on acpInput (first lock), explicit getReader() call caused second lock attempt, violating ReadableStream single-reader constraint. Removal allows protocol handshake to complete successfully while lifecycle management is handled automatically by framework and protocol layers
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Blast radius: Single endpoint (/acp/stream). Risk: LOW - removal of problematic code matches proven CLI pattern. Downstream: No changes needed. Benefits: Unblocks entire ACP TCP transport, enables hierarchical composition, validates devbob-to-devbob delegation. Direct dependencies (AgentSideConnection, ndJsonStream, Hono stream helper, TCPTransport) all continue working without modification. All consumers (transport, acp_delegate tool, test scripts, validation harnesses) now able to function correctly

dataFlowAfterEnforcement: TCPTransport.connect() → TransformStream → POST /acp/stream → HTTP 200 → acpInput/acpOutput creation → ndJsonStream(acpOutput, acpInput) [single lock] → ACP.init({ sdk, defaultModel }) [no self-call] → AgentSideConnection [ready] → Protocol handshake succeeds → Connection lifecycle managed by framework

downstream: Completes Phase 1 of ACP network transport spec
